instruction.text: The Smiths have an apple tree. Last year, the tree produced 30 `kg` of apples. This year, it only produced one third of last year’s harvest. Work out how many kilograms the apple tree produced this year.
instruction.sound: The Smiths have an apple tree. Last year, the tree produced 30kg of apples. This year, it only produced one third of last year’s harvest. Work out how many kilograms the apple tree produced this year.

instruction.text: Mona the giraffe weighed 70 `kg` when she was born. Now she has grown to be nine times her weight at birth. Work out how many kilograms Mona weighs now.
instruction.sound: Mona the giraffe weighed 70 kg when she was born. Now she has grown to be nine times her weight at birth. Work out how many kilograms Mona weighs now.

instruction.text: Work out the difference in her current weight and her weight at birth to find out how much weight Mona has gained.
